An [[Atha'an Miere]] [[Windfinder]] who came to [[Caemlyn]] with [[Elayne Trakand]].{{ref|{{twotc}}|comp}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Faeral has a strength in the [[One Power]] of {{opsl|25}}, making her moderately strong compared to most Aes Sedai.{{ref||comp}}

==Activities==
She accompanied [[Renaile din Calon Blue Star]] to the [[Tarasin Palace]], then to the [[Kin's Farm]].

She observed, but not take part in, the use of the [[Bowl of the Winds]].

Afterwards, she was part of the group that fled with Elayne to [[Caemlyn]].{{ref||comp}}

==Trivia==
This character is only mentioned in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]].
